items.exampleEn: Cooking is one of my interests.
This old photograph shows my grandparents.
items.exampleZh: 這張老照片裡是我的爺爺奶奶。

items.exampleEn: I'm reading a long novel about a family.
items.exampleZh: 我正在讀一本關於一個家族的長篇小說。

items.exampleEn: Everyone called him a hero after he saved the boy.
items.exampleZh: 他救了那個男孩之後，大家都說他是英雄。

items.exampleEn: She comes from a musical family.
The police are trying to solve the mystery.
items.exampleZh: 警方正在設法解開這個謎。

items.exampleEn: My son made a drawing of our cat.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子畫了一張我們家貓的畫。

items.exampleEn: This song has a fast rhythm.

items.sentenceEn: She keeps an old photograph in her wallet.
items.sentenceZh: 她把一張舊照片放在皮夾裡。

items.audioEn: I love mystery novels. I read one every week.
items.audioZh: 我很愛推理小說，每個星期都讀一本。
items.questionZh: 說話的人多常讀推理小說？

items.sentenceEn: Dancing helps you feel the rhythm.
In this story, a young girl becomes a hero.
items.sentenceZh: 在這個故事裡，一個年輕女孩成了英雄。

items.stemEn: Nobody knows who took my bike. It's a ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有人知道是誰牽走了我的腳踏車，這真是個謎。

items.stemEn: Do you have any ____ in sports?

items.passageEn: Nina has many interests. She loves reading, especially mystery novels. Her favorite hero is a clever old lady who solves strange problems. Nina is also musical. She can play the guitar and has a good sense of rhythm. On her bedroom wall, there are some of her own drawings and an old photograph of her grandmother.
items.passageZh: Nina 有很多興趣。她很愛看書，尤其是推理小說。她最喜歡的主角是一位會解開怪事的聰明老太太。Nina 也很有音樂天分，會彈吉他，節奏感也很好。她房間的牆上有她自己畫的圖，還有一張她奶奶的老照片。

questions.questionZh: Nina 最喜歡哪一類小說？
Nina 房間的牆上有什麼？
options: 一個擺滿推理小說的大書架
一把舊吉他和幾張樂團海報
她畫的圖和奶奶的老照片

referenceEn: I have a great interest in drawing.
I am very interested in drawing.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 have a great interest in、am very interested in
in 後面接名詞或動名詞（例如 in drawing）

items.promptZh: 這部電影的主角是一隻小狗。
referenceEn: The hero of this movie is a little dog.
This movie's hero is a small dog.
rubricZh: 用 hero 表示「（故事的）主角」（例如 the hero of this movie、this movie's hero 等）
